description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would advance to a new Reckoning stage.

Once per day, delay a Reckoning stage's onset until the end of the scene.

You hold the ledger open a moment longer. The new stage does not take effect yet: you continue at your current stage, and its toll arrives in full at the end of the current scene. You cannot delay the same stage twice, and delaying does not reduce, cancel, or reorder anything — the price is the same price, paid late.

cinderfall.incomplete: Delaying a Reckoning-stage toll -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER).
